findings.description: The crouch and sit previews show the new lower-rise textile bridge without an obvious skin-through opening from these camera views. This is a visual observation of V14 only; no side-by-side comparative gain, clearance, strain, boundary coverage from other angles, or pose acceptance is claimed. Shorts fit remains unverified.
Back, crouch and sit renders still show an angular raised rear block and narrow pointed cloth tails under the seat. Silhouette and pose deformation remain rejected.
Front, side, arms-up and arm-cross renders still show triangular faceting across sleeves, shoulders, side torso and waist. Surface quality is rejected.

nextAction: V14 shows a visible shorts-bridge change, but keep appearance rejected and release blocked: redesign rear overskirt volume/panel support to remove pointed tails and blocky seat collapse, then repair jacket topology/faceting. Preserve the new crotch bridge for fit/clearance review; do not mark fit accepted. Re-render all poses after changes. UV remains NOT_CREATED; target runtime, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat, package and release remain UNVERIFIED.
